targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Total" FROM inspections WHERE $__timeFilter(inspection_date);

panels.description:
A Pass notice will be issued when only minor or no infractions are observed during an inspection.

If minor infractions are repeated at the next inspection, the Public Health Inspector may issue a ticket to obtain compliance. Fines range from $55 to $465 depending on the severity of the infraction.

Minor infraction type:
- Infractions that present a minimal health risk
- These items must be corrected by the next inspection

Examples:
- Walls, floors or other non-food contact surfaces or equipment need cleaning or repair (e.g., cracked or missing floor tiles, cracked or peeling paint not directly over food preparation area)
- Inadequate ventilation and lighting systems
- Hair constraints not worn

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Total" FROM inspections WHERE $__timeFilter(inspection_date))
 -(SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Closed" FROM inspections WHERE severity = 'C - Crucial' AND $__timeFilter(inspection_date))
 -(SELECT COUNT(*) AS "cond_pass" FROM inspections WHERE severity = 'S - Significant' AND $__timeFilter(inspection_date))
 AS Difference

panels.title: Pass

targets.rawSql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::numeric AS total,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'S - Significant')::numeric AS conditional_pass,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'C - Crucial')::numeric AS closed
  FROM inspections
  WHERE $__timeFilter(inspection_date)
)
SELECT COALESCE((total - conditional_pass - closed) / NULLIF(total, 0), 0) AS "Pass %"
FROM counts;

panels.description:
A conditional pass notice will be issued when one or more significant infractions are observed during an inspection.

Significant infraction types:
- Infractions that present a potential health hazard
- These items must be corrected within 24-48 hours or legal action may be taken
- These items indirectly involve food, through handling, preparation, storage and/or service

Examples:
- Food contact surfaces or equipment require cleaning or repair
- Repair of refrigeration and mechanical dish washing equipment required
- Accurate indicating thermometers not provided
- Lack of hand wash basin with the necessary supplies
- Garbage not stored in a sanitary manner
- Improper cleaning and sanitizing of equipment and utensils
- Washroom cleanliness not maintained, supplies not provided

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "cond_pass" FROM inspections WHERE severity = 'S - Significant' AND $__timeFilter(inspection_date);

panels.title: Conditional Pass

targets.rawSql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::numeric AS total,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'S - Significant')::numeric AS conditional_pass
  FROM inspections
  WHERE $__timeFilter(inspection_date)
)
SELECT COALESCE(conditional_pass / NULLIF(total, 0), 0) AS "Conditional Pass %"
FROM counts;

panels.description:
A closed notice will be issued when one or more crucial infractions observed during an inspection are not corrected immediately. A food establishment can only be closed when a health hazard is present.

Crucial infraction type:
- Infractions that present an immediate health hazard
- These items directly involve food, such as contamination, time-temperature abuse or lack of safe (potable) water or any other condition that is a health hazard
- These items must be corrected immediately or an Order to Close the premises can be issued and/or immediate action must be taken to remove or eliminate the health hazard
- Enforcement action will be taken

Examples:
- No hot and cold running water under pressure in food preparation area or where utensils are washed
- Rodent or insect infestation without effective method of pest control
- Inadequate refrigeration
- Sewage back-up
- Lack of safe potable water
- Food contaminated or adulterated

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Closed" FROM inspections WHERE severity = 'C - Crucial' AND $__timeFilter(inspection_date);

panels.title: Closed

targets.rawSql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::numeric AS total,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'C - Crucial')::numeric AS closed
  FROM inspections
  WHERE $__timeFilter(inspection_date)
)
SELECT COALESCE(closed / NULLIF(total, 0), 0) AS "Closed %"
FROM counts;
SELECT date_trunc('week', inspection_date) AS "time", COUNT(*) AS "Inspections" FROM inspections WHERE $__timeFilter(inspection_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT CASE EXTRACT(dow FROM inspection_date) WHEN 0 THEN 'Sun' WHEN 1 THEN 'Mon' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tue' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wed' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thu' WHEN 5 THEN 'Fri' WHEN 6 THEN 'Sat' END AS "Day", COUNT(*) AS "Inspections" FROM inspections WHERE $__timeFilter(inspection_date) GROUP BY EXTRACT(dow FROM inspection_date), 1 ORDER BY EXTRACT(dow FROM inspection_date);

SELECT Action, COUNT(Action) AS "Inspection Result"
FROM inspections WHERE $__timeFilter(inspection_date)
GROUP BY Action
ORDER BY COUNT(Action) DESC

panels.description: There are three types of infractions that have been developed under the DineSafe Food Safety Inspection and Disclosure Program (Crucial, Significant and Minor) covering all of the requirements under the Ontario Food Premises Regulation (493/17). These infractions will be identified on the Food Safety Inspection Report at the time of inspection.

targets.rawSql:
WITH severity_levels AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    VALUES
      ('NA', 1),
      ('No infractions', 2),
      ('M - Minor', 3),
      ('S - Significant', 4),
      ('C - Crucial', 5)
  ) AS levels(severity, sort_order)
), severity_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(severity, ''), 'No infractions') AS severity, COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM inspections
  WHERE $__timeFilter(inspection_date)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT levels.severity AS "Severity", COALESCE(counts.count, 0) AS "Count"
FROM severity_levels AS levels
LEFT JOIN severity_counts AS counts ON counts.severity = levels.severity
ORDER BY levels.sort_order;

panels.title: Severity Breakdown

panels.description:
Crucial Infractions - Immediate Health Hazard

These infractions must be corrected immediately. An order to close the premises may be issued and/or immediate action must be taken to remove or eliminate the health hazard. A Closed Notice will be issued and must be posted, and other enforcement action will be taken. Crucial infractions are conditions that endanger food directly, such as contamination, time-temperature abuse or lack of safe-to-drink water or any other condition that constitutes a health hazard.

targets.rawSql: SELECT establishment_type AS "Type", COUNT(*) AS "Crucial" FROM inspections WHERE severity = 'C - Crucial' AND establishment_type IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(inspection_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10;

Legal action may be taken should these infractions remain outstanding. Under exceptional circumstances a re-inspection to check for compliance may be extended beyond 48 hours. Significant infractions concern food handling, preparation, storage and/or service.
